detail.longDescription:
R Discovery is your #1 place to discover research literature, stay current, and read what matters faster. Built for students, researchers, clinicians, educators, and academics, R Discovery helps you find relevant papers without spending hours searching across scattered sources.

With research-grade AI workflows, R Discovery accelerates every step of your literature journey: discover papers, understand key findings, chat with PDFs, listen to research, translate papers, and build a personalized academic library around your interests. We search, curate, summarize, and organize the literature so you can spend more time on meaningful research and more time with the people you love.

R Discovery gives you access to:
• 150M+ journal articles
• 78M+ open access papers
• 10M+ conference documents
• 5M+ preprints
• 7.5M+ patents
• 8M+ summaries and highlights
• 9.5M+ research topics
• 14M+ authors
• 64K+ journals
• 120K+ universities and institutions

Why researchers use R Discovery:
• Personalized research feeds based on your interests
• Fast literature search for papers, journals, authors, topics, and institutions
• Reliable, clean research database built to reduce duplication and low-quality content
• Open access discovery so you can quickly find papers you can read
• Full-text access with institutional login through GetFTR and LibKey integrations
• Alerts for newly published papers in your field
• Summaries and highlights to assess relevance faster
• Bookmarks and reading lists to organize your library

Upgrade to R Discovery Prime to accelerate your research further with unlimited access for research-grade AI workflows
• Ask R Discovery for reference-backed answers from research papers
• Chat with PDFs and get instant answers from full papers
• Listen to papers with audio streaming for research on the go
• Translate research papers into your preferred language
• Sync your saved papers with Zotero and Mendeley

R Discovery partners with leading global publishers, societies, and research platforms including Wiley, IOP Publishing, Springer Nature, Sage, Taylor & Francis, Hindawi, NEJM, Emerald Publishing, Duke University Press, IntechOpen, AIAA, Karger, Underline.io, J-STAGE, and more.

Join 3M+ academics on R Discovery, the highest rated app in this space with a 4.6+ App Store rating. Free to use, or upgrade to R Discovery Prime for unlimited premium access. Get it now!
